title: Marker token is a plain regex, not a docstring parser
context: Alternative approaches: parse docstrings to extract markers; use code-generation annotations; require specific file structure.
decision: The marker token is a fixed string `@kaava:<uuid> <slug>` found by plain regular expression anywhere in a source file. The UUID is authoritative; the slug is for human readability. A docstring parser breaks on the first unanticipated language.
consequences: Marker can be placed anywhere; no fragility from docstring parsing; humans can grep for readable names; the trailing slug is optional for parsing but essential for usability; reconciliation relies on the regex and UUID only.
